title: Slow-Cooker Broccoli and Sun-Dried Tomato Lasagne
changes_from_base: Blanched broccoli and sun-dried tomatoes go into an oregano and chilli ricotta layer, shop-bought tomato sauce replaces the meat ragù and béchamel, and the lasagne is layered and gently cooked in a foil-lined slow cooker.
summary: A gently cooked lasagne layered with tender broccoli, tangy sun-dried tomatoes and a herby ricotta, all bubbling under a blanket of melted mozzarella.

ingredients.item: broccoli florets, cut into 5 cm pieces
fine sea salt or table salt, for the cooking water
curly-edged dried lasagne sheets (8), broken in half
sun-dried tomatoes in oil, patted dry and quartered
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Line
steps.text: Fit a folded foil collar round the slow cooker insert, then press 2 large foil sheets in crosswise with plenty overhanging to form a sling and grease it lightly.

steps.title: Blanch
steps.text: Bring about 4000 ml water to the boil, add the 340 g broccoli florets and 1 tbsp salt and cook about 3 min until bright green and just tender, lift onto kitchen paper, cool a little and chop roughly.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Return the water to the boil, cook the 8 broken sheets until al dente stirring often, then drain, rinse under cold water and lay flat on clean tea towels.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Combine the 455 g ricotta, 50 g of the parmesan, the 120 g sun-dried tomatoes, egg, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp chilli flakes, ½ tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Spread 120 ml sauce in the cooker, then add 4 sheet pieces, 10 heaped tablespoons of the ricotta mix, a third of the broccoli, a quarter of the mozzarella and 120 ml sauce, and repeat twice.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Top with the last 4 pieces, the remaining 240 ml sauce, the rest of the 455 g mozzarella and the remaining parmesan.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours until piping hot right through.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Leave 20 min, then lift out with the sling if you wish, discard any juices and serve.

tips: Pat the sun-dried tomatoes really dry so the ricotta layer does not turn oily.
Lay the cooked sheets on tea towels rather than kitchen paper, which tends to stick.
Make the foil sling long and overhanging so you can lift the whole lasagne out cleanly.
storage: Chill leftovers within 2 hours and keep for up to 3 days.
